preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 300,000.
The number of weights must be equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w <= 10**12 for w in weights)
preconditions.description: Each weight must be between 1 and 10^12.
The number of edges connecting odd vertices must be n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y, _, _ in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.
Each edge weight must be between 1 and 10^12.
The number of queries must be between 1 and 600,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= 2*n and 1 <= v <= 2*n and u != v for u, v in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must involve distinct vertices within the range 1 to 2n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly q integers, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(o, int) and o >= 0 for o in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value must be a non-negative integer representing the shortest path length.

postconditions.expression: all(o == min_path_length(u, v) for u, v, o in zip(queries, output))
postconditions.description: Each output value must correctly represent the shortest path length between the queried vertices.
